messages:
Maya (CSE): Quick heads-up — Trailblazer cohort kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT (10 accounts). Need a very short runbook so we don't get bogged down: 1) confirm enrollments, 2) enablement session + Q&A, 3) intake survey results review, 4) owner assignments, 5) capture any renewal/risks. RSVP: https://link.redwood/trailblazer-rsvp
Diego (CSE): Confirmed attendees: Acme, Zephyr. I have a conflict at 10am — can we shift train-the-trainer to 11am? :thinking_face:
Amir (CSM): Heads-up — FinEdge asked about data residency and mentioned procurement timeline that could touch renewal. Marking as medium risk until we confirm KMS SLA. @Ivy can you take point?
Ivy (Onboarding): I can take FinEdge. Set 1:1 with their security lead and will pull KMS + SOC docs. Also happy to run the enablement if we keep the session at 10am. :ok_hand:
Maya (CSE): If Ivy runs enablement, let's make the agenda tight: 20m demo (model pinning & rollout), 25m Q&A (integration patterns + observability), 10m account-specific breakouts. I'll publish a one-pager.
product-bot: Calendar invite created: "Trailblazer Cohort Kickoff" — 2026-05-12T17:00Z — https://calendar.redwood/evt/abcd1234
Diego (CSE): Agenda looks good. Quick ask: do we have funnel metrics from the intake form so we can call out common blockers? Especially want drop-off by step.
Maya (CSE): Yep — intake sheet + dashboard here: https://docs.redwood/trailblazer-enroll. Current drop-off is ~18% on the billing info step and ~7% on 'integration type'. Suggest a reminder email + inline help for billing.
Amir (CSM): I'll draft a short renewal-risk note for FinEdge and circulate. Will reference the compliance checklist: https://internal.redwood/compliance-checklist (attach to the ticket).
Ivy (Onboarding): 1:1 scheduled with FinEdge for Thu 9am PT. I'll add notes to CS notes and flag any contract blockers. Also I'll prep a one-slide KMS primer for the enablement deck.
Maya (CSE): Thanks team. Final ask: owners — Diego you own enrollment confirmations for Acme/Zephyr; Amir you own FinEdge risk comms; Ivy owns enablement/runbook. If anyone can't join tomorrow, ping me and we'll record. :pray: 
Diego (CSE): Got it, recording requested. Will follow up on timing change if needed. :thumbsup:
Amir (CSM): Thanks — I'll share the draft renewal note by EOD.
Ivy (Onboarding): Will upload deck + breakout list by 8pm PT tonight.
Maya (CSE): Perfect. Closing loop — I'll post final agenda + attendee list in this thread 1h before kickoff.
